title: Kaempferol 3-O-gentiobioside, an ALK5 inhibitor, affects the proliferation, migration, and invasion of tumor cells via blockade of the TGF-beta/ALK5/Smad signaling pathway.
authors: Zhang, Zihao; Qiao, Yu; Yang, Li; Chen, Zuwang; Li, Tao; Gu, MingZhen; Li, Chong; Liu, Mingming; Li, Rong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物KPF 3-O-G抑制ALK5激酶及TGF-beta信号通路抗肿瘤，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Overactivation of TGF-beta/ALK5/Smad signaling pathway has been observed in the advanced stage of various human malignancies. As a key component of TGF-beta/ALK5/Smad signaling pathway transduction, TGF-beta type I receptor (also known as ALK5) has emerged as a promising therapeutic target for cancer treatment. In this study, to discover a novel ALK5 inhibitor, a commercial natural products library was screened using docking-based virtual screening, followed by luciferase reporter assay. A flavonoid glycoside kaempferol 3-O-gentiobioside (KPF 3-O-G) was identified as a potent ALK5 inhibitor through directly bound to the ATP-site of ALK5, resulting in the inhibitory effects on phosphorylation and translocation of Smad2 and expression of Smad4. Additionally, we found that KPF 3-O-G reduced cell proliferation and inhibited TGF-beta-induced cell migration and invasion. Moreover, western blotting and immunofluorescent analysis showed that KPF 3-O-G significantly reversed the TGF-beta-induced EMT biomarkers, including upregulation of E-cadherin and downregulation of N-cadherin, vimentin, and snail. In vivo study showed that KPF 3-O-G administration reduced tumor growth in human ovarian cancer xenograft mouse model, without obvious toxic effect. This study provided novel insight into the anticancer effects of KPF-3-O-G and indicated that KPF-3-O-G might be developed as potential therapeutics for cancer treatment after further validation.
abstract_zh: 在多种人类恶性肿瘤的晚期阶段，已观察到TGF-beta/ALK5/Smad信号通路的过度激活。作为TGF-beta/ALK5/Smad信号通路转导的关键组成部分，TGF-beta I型受体（又称ALK5）已成为癌症治疗中一个有前景的治疗靶点。本研究中，为发现新型ALK5抑制剂，我们利用基于对接的虚拟筛选对商业天然产物库进行了筛选，随后进行了荧光素酶报告基因检测。一种黄酮苷类化合物山柰酚3-O-龙胆二糖苷（KPF 3-O-G）被鉴定为有效的ALK5抑制剂，其通过直接结合ALK5的ATP位点，从而抑制Smad2的磷酸化和转位以及Smad4的表达。此外，我们发现KPF 3-O-G能减少细胞增殖，并抑制TGF-beta诱导的细胞迁移和侵袭。进一步地，蛋白质印迹和免疫荧光分析显示，KPF 3-O-G显著逆转了TGF-beta诱导的上皮-间质转化（EMT）生物标志物，包括上调E-钙粘蛋白和下调N-钙粘蛋白、波形蛋白和蜗牛蛋白。体内研究表明，在人类卵巢癌异种移植小鼠模型中，给予KPF 3-O-G可减少肿瘤生长，且无明显毒性效应。本研究为KPF-3-O-G的抗癌作用提供了新见解，并表明KPF-3-O-G在进一步验证后可能被开发为癌症治疗的潜在药物。
